title: Girlfriend and boyfriend
simplified_paragraphs: A：你手机上的那个女孩儿是你的女朋友吗？
B：不是，她是我的大学同学。你觉得她怎么样？
A：她很漂亮！你看，她长长的头发，大大的眼睛，又高又瘦。你为什么有她的照片？你喜欢她，对吗？
B：哈哈，是的，我很喜欢她。希望有一天她真的能成为我的女朋友。你呢？你喜欢什么样的男孩儿？
A：我喜欢个子高高的，不胖也不瘦，干干净净的男孩儿。当然，他最好喜欢运动，还喜欢音乐和电影。他还得聪明、善良，对所有人都很友好……
B：你要求太多了！这就是为什么你现在还没有男朋友。

B：不是，她是我的大學同學。你覺得她怎麼樣？
A：她很漂亮！你看，她長長的頭髮，大大的眼睛，又高又瘦。你為什麼有她的照片？你喜歡她，對嗎？
B：哈哈，是的，我很喜歡她。希望有一天她真的能成為我的女朋友。你呢？你喜歡什麼樣的男孩兒？
A：我喜歡個子高高的，不胖也不瘦，乾乾淨淨的男孩兒。當然，他最好喜歡運動，還喜歡音樂和電影。他還得聰明、善良，對所有人都很友好……
B：你要求太多了！這就是為什麼你現在還沒有男朋友。
pinyin_paragraphs: A： nǐ shǒu jī shàng de nà gè nǚ hái r shì nǐ de nǚ péng you ma？
B： bù shì， tā shì wǒ de dà xué tóng xué。 nǐ jué de tā zěn me yàng？
A： tā hěn piào liang！ nǐ kàn， tā cháng cháng de tóu fa， dà dà de yǎn jing， yòu gāo yòu shòu。 nǐ wèi shén me yǒu tā de zhào piàn？ nǐ xǐ huan tā， duì ma？
B： hā hā， shì de， wǒ hěn xǐ huan tā。 xī wàng yǒu yī tiān tā zhēn de néng chéng wéi wǒ de nǚ péng you。 nǐ ne？ nǐ xǐ huan shén me yàng de nán hái r？

A： wǒ xǐ huan gè zi gāo gāo de， bù pàng yě bù shòu， gān gān jìng jìng de nán hái r。 dāng rán， tā zuì hǎo xǐ huan yùn dòng， hái xǐ huan yīn yuè hé diàn yǐng。 tā hái děi cōng míng、 shàn liáng， duì suǒ yǒu rén dōu hěn yǒu hǎo ……
B： nǐ yāo qiú tài duō le！ zhè jiù shì wèi shén me nǐ xiàn zài hái méi yǒu nán péng you。
english_paragraphs: A: Is that girl on your phone your girlfriend?
B: No, she is my college classmate. What do you think of her?
A: She is beautiful! You see, she has long hair, big eyes, and is tall and thin. Why do you have a picture of her? You like her, right?
B: Haha, yes, I like her very much. Hope she can really be my girlfriend one day. And you? What kind of boy do you like?
A: I like boys who are tall, neither fat nor thin, and clean. Of course, he'd better like sports, music and movies. He also has to be smart, kind, and friendly to everyone...
B: You ask too much! That's why you don't have a boyfriend yet.
english_full:
A: Is that girl on your phone your girlfriend?

B: No, she is my college classmate. What do you think of her?

A: She is beautiful! You see, she has long hair, big eyes, and is tall and thin. Why do you have a picture of her? You like her, right?

B: Haha, yes, I like her very much. Hope she can really be my girlfriend one day. And you? What kind of boy do you like?

A: I like boys who are tall, neither fat nor thin, and clean. Of course, he'd better like sports, music and movies. He also has to be smart, kind, and friendly to everyone...

B: You ask too much! That's why you don't have a boyfriend yet.
